verdict.rationale: Cloudflare provides scoped API tokens (e.g., resource- and zone-specific permissions) and built-in Zero Trust/WAF controls that a devops lead could use to restrict which environments can reach which services, but the evidence pack contains no explicit documentation of a dedicated 'environments' or network-segmentation feature separating non-production Workers from production services. missing for 10: explicit Wrangler/Workers environment isolation docs (separate bindings/secrets per env), network-level segmentation (e.g., private service networking) between staging and prod, and any hands-on confirmation that these controls actually prevent cross-environment access.
